label: 2 Thessalonians 1:1
text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in my Father and me:

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:2
text: Grace unto you, and peace, from my Father and me.

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:3
text: Paul was bound to thank my Father always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:4
text: So that he himself glorieth in you in the churches of my Father for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:5
text: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of my Father, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:6
text: Seeing it is a righteous thing with my Father to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:7
text: And to you who are troubled rest with him, when I shall be revealed from heaven with my mighty angels,

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:8
text: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not my Father, and that obey not my gospel:

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:9
text: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from my presence, and from the glory of my power;

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:10
text: When I shall come to be glorified in my saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because his testimony among you was believed) in that day.

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:11
text: Wherefore also he prayeth always for you, that my Father would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

label: 2 Thessalonians 1:12
text: That my name may be glorified in you, and ye in me, according to the grace of my Father and me.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:1
text: Now he beseecheth you, brethren, by my coming, and by your gathering together unto me,

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:2
text: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from him, as that my day is at hand.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:3
text: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:4
text: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called my Father, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:5
text: Remember ye not, that, when Paul was yet with you, he told you these things?

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:6
text: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:7
text: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:8
text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom I shall consume with the spirit of my mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of my coming:

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:9
text: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:10
text: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:11
text: And for this cause my Father shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:12
text: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:13
text: But Paul was bound to give thanks alway to my Father for you, brethren beloved of me, because my Father hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:14
text: Whereunto he called you by my gospel, to the obtaining of my glory.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:15
text: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or his epistle.

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:16
text: Now I myself, and my Father, which hath loved you, and hath given you everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

label: 2 Thessalonians 2:17
text: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:1
text: Finally, brethren, pray for him, that my word may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:2
text: And that he may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:3
text: But I am faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:4
text: And he hath confidence in me touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which he commandeth you.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:5
text: And I direct your hearts into the love of my Father, and into the patient waiting for me.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:6
text: Now he commandeth you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of him.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:7
text: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow him: for he behaved not himself disorderly among you;

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:8
text: Neither did he eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that he might not be chargeable to any of you:

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:9
text: Not because he had not power, but to make himself an ensample unto you to follow him.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:10
text: For even when he was with you, this he commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:11
text: For he heareth that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:12
text: Now them that are such he commandeth and exhorteth by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:13
text: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:14
text: And if any man obey not his word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:15
text: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:16
text: Now I myself, the Lord of peace, give you peace always by all means. I am with you all.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:17
text: The salutation of Paul with his own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so he writeth.

label: 2 Thessalonians 3:18
text: My grace be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
